import polars as pl

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    null_values = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null"]

    def clean_col(col_name: str) -> pl.Expr:
        s = pl.col(col_name).str.strip_chars()
        # replace null values with None before mapping
        s = pl.when(s.is_in(null_values)).then(None).otherwise(s)
        return s

    return raw.select(
        contact_id=clean_col("Contact ID").str.to_uppercase(),
        full_name=clean_col("Full Name"),
        email=clean_col("Email").str.to_lowercase(),
        phone=clean_col("Phone"),
        company=clean_col("Company"),
        created_on=clean_col("Created On").str.to_date(format="%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
        lifetime_value=clean_col("Lifetime Value").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2)
    )
